en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Muhammad Al Kufy, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad Al Nahdy, from Muhammad Bin Al Waleed, from Aban Bin Usman, from Ismail Bin Abdul Rahman Al Ju’fy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>

regarding a slave girl between two men. One of them copulated with her besides the other (without his companion’s knowledge), so he impregnated her. Heasws said: ‘He would be struck with half the Penalty (Hadd), and compensate half her price’.
